decisions.final_expr: (or (finding (snomed_concept "Clinical finding" "finding") (snomed_concept "Eruption caused by drug" "disorder")) (diagnosis (snomed_concept "Eruption caused by drug" "disorder") possible))
decisions.reason: The fixed-drug-eruption box sits inside "Approach to the patient with a drug rash", so the drug rash is the page's context; "following ingestion of a medication" is implied by it, and using it keeps one medication concept in the build. Either encoding fits the page, so the stand-in is listed as a clinician question.

notes: Both builds passed and agreed on 49 of 56/53 conditions. Final build is A unchanged.
